attacks.name: Shock Batons
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Shock|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: Widow Stingers
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Stun|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Deadly Origins
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!movement_medium|.

|!wild| |!hit| |*Finisher|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make a |*Shock Batons| attack. This character may reroll any number of its dice during that attack, including |!failure| results.

superPowers.name: Calculated Risk
superPowers.body: While this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!mystic| attack, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, it may use this superpower. This character may reroll any number of its defense dice, including |!failure| results.

superPowers.name: All that Matters is the Mission
superPowers.body: When this character would drop an objective token, its controlling player chooses where to Place the token instead of their opponent.

superPowers.name: Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, if this attacker is within |!range| 2, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.

The official French translation incorrectly translated both "Black Widow" and "The Black Widow" characters with the same name. Jarvis shows 2 different names for the sake of consistency with the original translations.
